5.7.5.9 ModeSwitchedAckEvent
Purpose:
A runnable entity triggered by the RTE to receive and process mode
switched acknowledgment notifications.
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_02758] ⌈
void <name>([IN Rte_Instance <instance>])
⌋(SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00122, SRS_Rte_00107)
Notes:
The runnable entity triggered by an ModeSwitchedAckEvent
should use the Rte_SwitchAck API to actually receive the status
of the acknowledgment.
